result.keywords: This article examines planning methods for coordinating autonomous seed packets inside saltwater-adjacent storage facilities. It develops a routing framework for lantern-guided carts operating across shifting dock schedules, with emphasis on humidity-safe transfer, tide-aware dispatch, and inventory balancing for archival seed banks. A simulation study compares fixed-route and adaptive-route policies under variable loading delays and sparse human supervision.
result.title: Lantern Routines for Coastal Seed Logistics in Tidal Warehouses.
